app.title: odin-app-template
app.intro: Reference canister app for building on Odin Fun. Auth is wired up with Odin Connect — deposit/withdraw flows and the multi-token ledger UI land in later subtasks.
app.connectPrompt: Connect with Odin to deposit, withdraw and view your balances.

deposit.heading: Deposit
deposit.note: Note: <0>deposit</0> pulls the approved funds via <1>icrc2_transfer_from</1> and credits your balance in one call — the credit is backed by tokens the canister actually moved, so no trusted minter is required.

withdraw.heading: Withdraw
withdraw.feeNote: Network fee: ~{{sats}} sats in BTC. You approve BTC on withdraw so the canister can cover the Odin ledger transfer fee — no canister float needed.
withdraw.noBalances: No internal balances to withdraw. Deposit some tokens first.

errors.feeApprovalRejected: BTC fee approval cancelled or rejected.

errors.amountGreaterThanZero: Amount must be greater than zero.
errors.canisterUnavailableDeposit: Canister unavailable — reconnect to enable deposits.
errors.canisterUnavailableWithdraw: Canister unavailable — reconnect to enable withdrawals.
errors.tokenInfoLoading: Token info still loading — try again in a moment.
